# C 是规律：在水平路径上，每个主张都算作活的扩展恰是扩大能形成者；把“更好”读作扩大，C 对 living 的每种读法成立，不用公理 / C is a law: on level paths an extension in which every claim counts as living is exactly a widening of what can form; with “better” read as widening, C holds for every reading of living, with no axiom

## 主张 Claim

在依存网的水平路径框架（Web.paths）上，主张是（形成，步），一条水平路径实现它恰当在该步接纳该形成。以每个主张都算作活，水平路径 l 对 l′ 的扩展（Extension：实现 l′ 实现的每个主张，并多实现一个）恰是 l 扩大 l′，即包含且超出它（Web.paths_extension_iff_widens）。对 living 的任何读法，扩展都是以每个主张为活的扩展，所以以“更好”读作扩大，C（每个扩展都更好）成立（Web.paths_comparison_widens），不用公理。以公理为条件，扩大就是保留且增加有意义者（Web.widens_iff_retains_adds，见 significance-retained-within-margin），所以水平路径上以公理推出的 C（Web.paths_g0_comparison，见 one-axiom-yields-g0）是它在意义上的读法。 / On the frame of a web's level paths (Web.paths), claims are pairs of a formation and a step, and a level path realizes one exactly when it admits the formation at that step. With every claim counting as living, an extension of l′ by l (Extension: realizing every claim l′ realizes, and one more) is exactly l widening l′, including and exceeding it (Web.paths_extension_iff_widens). For any reading of living, an extension is an extension with every claim living, so with “better” read as widening, C, that every extension is better, holds (Web.paths_comparison_widens), with no axiom. With the axiom as a condition, widening is retaining and adding what has significance (Web.widens_iff_retains_adds, see significance-retained-within-margin), so the C the axiom gives on level paths (Web.paths_g0_comparison, see one-axiom-yields-g0) is its reading in significance.

Canonical source: [Significance.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Significance.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 水平路径的框架（Web.paths）：主张是（形成，步），水平路径实现它恰当在该步接纳该形成；比较在任意两条水平路径之间。 / The frame of level paths (Web.paths): claims are pairs of a formation and a step, and a level path realizes one exactly when it admits the formation at that step; the comparison is between any two level paths.
- “更好”读作扩大能形成者（Web.Widens）；C 在这一读法下是定理，“更好”另作他读或在一般的框架上，C 仍是前提。 / “Better” is read as widening what can form (Web.Widens); C is a theorem on this reading, and remains a premise where “better” is read otherwise or on a general frame.
- 离散的步；自然数的水平与所需。 / Discrete steps; natural-number levels and needs.

Ren 2026-10-11 问：“can we reduce is "for anything, its continuation into the future leads to more futures(flourishes/plurality) from generatively" - so we can be like "these are space where generatively happens", which allows us to derive everything without axiom?”，并定：“as long as the derivation of the rules doesn't rely on axiom, don't use one”。AI 的读法：扩大读“leads to more futures”，Ren 已确认可能性读作接下来能形成的；生成的空间读作部分在其中扩大能形成者之处。“flourishes/plurality”是否都由扩大读出、它是否就是生生的空间，由 Ren 选择（章节 §8）。 / Ren asked on 11 October 2026: “can we reduce is "for anything, its continuation into the future leads to more futures(flourishes/plurality) from generatively" - so we can be like "these are space where generatively happens", which allows us to derive everything without axiom?”, and decided: “as long as the derivation of the rules doesn't rely on axiom, don't use one”. The AI's reading: widening reads “leads to more futures”, Ren having confirmed that possibilities are what can form next; the generative space is where a part widens what can form. Whether “flourishes/plurality” is read by widening alone, and whether it is the space of 生生, is Ren's choice (chapter section 8).

The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 53 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §78 of the integration note; not yet independently reviewed.

C 在这里是水平路径框架上的规律，“更好”读作扩大；在一般的框架上，或“更好”另作他读时，C 仍是前提。扩大是偏序，混合的部分不被定序，定序需要度量。把扩大称作“更好”的规范根据开放（章节 §8）：还原之后，公理的不变之步成为称生成的空间为好的内容。把扩大读作 Ren 的“更多的未来”与生生是 AI 的读法，待 Ren。不含伦理谓词。 / C is a law here on the frame of level paths, with “better” read as widening; on a general frame, or with “better” read otherwise, C remains a premise. Widening is a partial order: mixed parts are not ordered, and ordering them needs a measure. The normative warrant for calling widening “better” is open (chapter section 8): after the reduction, the axiom's step of invariance becomes the content of calling the generative space good. Reading widening as Ren's “more futures” and as 生生 is the AI's reading, pending Ren. No ethical predicate occurs.

- 扩大不为每对水平路径定序：输送者的部分使两条路径混合（Transfer.mixed，见 four-cases-of-a-part）。 / Widening does not order every pair of level paths: the conveyor's part leaves the two paths mixed (Transfer.mixed, see four-cases-of-a-part).
